notes.title: v0.17.2 – 2025-09-17 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix[/b] with Subportal Upgrade only accessing resources from the ships cargo not the base (while in the home Subspace).

[b]Artifact Gameplay[/b]
• Brand new feature: discover, conquer, and defend ancient Artifacts
• If you hold it, you can wield previously unobtainable powers
• Upgrade your Subportal to discover and join in

[b]General[/b]
• [new] Subspace exploration percentage is now shown in the Subportal, the overview button, and the subspace details page
• [new] Subspaces can now be fully backed up and restored, instead of just the player and base buildings. This adds more fault tolerance in case of a server crash or malfunction. It's currently in use with the new Artifacts and could later extend to weekly events and more
• [tune] Corrected some incorrect translations. @Lordwind
• [tune] Possibly improved Win+D focus change. @Yuhiu
• [tune] Shows a message on the premium purchase page if Steam overlays are disabled globally, not just when a purchase attempt fails
• [tune] Traders are more rare again, but offer deals that surpass those of the Marketplace
• [tune] Some hull enhancements or tier-ups showed the wrong duration. @Tobsucht
• [tune] Empty skill slots can no longer be dragged in the Shipyard
• [tune] Improved Compendium starter guide text and order. @EclipseYue
• [tune] Controller can now trigger the quick action at the Subportal and works properly with the Marketplace at the Flagship
• [tune] Buffs are now visible to everyone if a player with a buff jumps into a Subspace
• [tune] Unified UI button code for consistent behavior
• [tune] Level info button (bottom right corner) now looks more like a button, since it is clickable
• [tune] Tractor beam client-side prediction no longer kicks in if out of range. @Henry
• [tune] Gate Keeper no longer takes hull damage from the Fracture skill if obscured. @--__--
• [tune] Corrected UI layout for pinned technology group overview. @Sakuya
• [tune] Subportal upgrades are now accessible from all Subspaces, not just from home. @--__--
• [fix] Chat translations with some symbols failed to translate. @Lordwind
• [fix] Fixed an issue parsing text with higher-range letters (for example, Chinese)
• [fix] Subspaces no longer expire too early. @Lordwind

[b]Technical[/b]
• Improved logging system performance for game and server, mostly on the server (Phase 1/2)
• Started work on a custom performance profiler to improve performance and energy efficiency
• Improved network connection negotiation code and reduced memory footprint
• Many other fixes and improvements throughout the codebase

notes.title: v0.15.0 - 2025-03-26
notes.content:
[b]Skill Update[/b]
• [new] Cannon: Barrage class skill added – unleashes a devastating barrage, firing three projectiles in rapid succession three times
• [new] Laser: Solar Lance class skill added – fires a continuous laser, dealing increasing damage over time
• [tune] Skill radius is now animated and tints the background to improve visibility
• [tune] Some combat skills can now be triggered out of combat
• [tune] Skill usage can be canceled
• [tune] Skills can now have their own icons – new icons will be added in the future
• [tune] Absorber damage has been further reduced, as it will be replaced soon

[b]Store Update and Sale[/b]
• Subscription model removed! Packages are now permanent
• To celebrate this, all packages are currently on sale until April 6
• Subspace Pioneer is now a permanent package – previously limited to Early Access + 6 months. Benefits slightly adjusted.
• Introducing Subspace Captain – a new permanent package that replaces the old subscription and includes all its benefits
• Free upgrades: If you’ve spent money before, you’ll automatically receive a permanent package matching your total spend – be sure to claim it from your mailbox at your base
• The package you receive is based on your total spending with a bonus, and converted into a matching permanent package – for free

[b]General[/b]
• [tune] Damage numbers in combat now have an improved spread to reduce overlap
• [tune] Support tickets should now show the unread indicator more reliably
• [tune] Enemies lurking behind asteroids will no longer jump onto players in their Spacecraft
• [tune] You can now replace a module in the module bar with the same type, even if the limit has already been reached
• [tune] Starting next season, the new base layout will remain consistent instead of shifting randomly due to varying positions on the hex grid
• [tune] Game trailer tools improved in preparation for producing more video material

notes.title: Mysterious Items
notes.content:
STU Discovery has detected peculiar items scattered throughout Subspace. Their origins and purpose remain unknown, but gathering these mysterious items could be crucial in uncovering their secrets.  
Join the investigation and help solve the mystery!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/88770d4cbde27e2afe5d35f37b4c6e16922aea01.png[/img]  
The first discovery of these strange items was made by an intrepid explorer, Starbuilder2050, during a routine patrol of Subspace.  
Soon after, SourSixteenCandL stumbled upon another fragment, sparking intrigue among the research community. Not long after, Chillso and Xepo6opo each reported similar findings in distant regions.  

These discoveries have ignited a wave of curiosity across Subspace—what could these mysterious items hold? Only time will tell.

[h1]Combat Update - In Development[/h1]

[b]Experience System Adjusted[/b]
• The goal was to bring all systems that gain experience into line. Instead of gaining experience based on the percentage of damage dealt to the enemy or asteroid cell, it is now based on the time spent actually attacking or mining.
• This results in group play receiving more experience than before, especially if some players were lower in level compared to the highest damage dealer.
• Mining an asteroid gains around 25% less experience. However, asteroids will no longer drop refined material but will instead grant up to 100% additional experience points. Refining resources now grants about 50% less experience than before.
• Combat experience stays the same.
• With the coming updates, more skills will be added, which all contribute to gaining more experience. Once this is in, a rebalancing will take place again to ensure smooth and similar progression for all classes.

notes.title: Major Updates Since Early Access Launch in Subspace Discovery!
notes.content:
[h2]Roadmap and New Features in Subspace Discovery[/h2]
Over the past year, since the launch of Early Access on Steam, Subspace Discovery has seen a multitude of new features and improvements that have significantly enriched your gameplay experience.
As the main developer (Pierre aka Xood), I've been hard at work, listening to your feedback and pushing the boundaries of what Subspace can offer. Here's a look at the most impactful additions and updates.

[h2]Roadmap of 2023 Completed[/h2]
[h3]Shipyard, Tech Tree, and the Forge[/h3]
The introduction of the new Shipyard, Tech Tree, and Forge represents a cornerstone update for the game. These systems have been revamped to be more intuitive, offer more depth and customization options, allowing you to build and enhance your ships with greater precision. The new module slot system and the ability to recycle hulls and modules ensure that you have more flexibility and strategic choices in your shipbuilding endeavors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/8a857eedda400ec2c6206b13293fae736c552034.jpg[/img]

[h3]Community Acknowledgment and Gratitude[/h3]
The community's support and feedback have been instrumental in shaping Subspace Discovery. With an average of 300 play sessions daily, active players drive the game forward. Special thanks to top contributors like @Sakuya, @Dangerous, @--__--, @Valens Rahl, and @Taromir for their impactful insights. I also appreciate the valuable discussions and feedback from the Discord community. Your enthusiasm and suggestions are at the heart of the game's success.
Thank you to everyone who purchased the Subspace Pioneer and the new Subspace License, and to everyone for being part of this journey!

[h3]Discovery of Skills[/h3]
Unexpected but welcome additions included the first set of Skills, such as the EMP and various attack skills, alongside new HUD systems. These features can now be discovered and unlocked, offering you new ways to enhance your gameplay and strategy. The next major update will focus on expanding these further, among other improvements.

[h3]Combat and Exploration Enhancements[/h3]
Combat and exploration have been enriched with new asteroid clusters, presenting challenges for low to mid-level players. Subspace now harbors hidden threats and the mysterious Subspace Boss, offering thrilling encounters. Additionally, the STU has launched their own vessel into subspace, expanding your opportunities for exploration and trade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/ae594051553fa13cc8f750ab3a19bba1e8c3455a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
Loot collection is now unlimited by daily caps, allowing for more freedom in gathering resources. Also, season endings will no longer result in the permanent loss of custom ships, ensuring your progress and hard work are preserved, making the gameplay experience more rewarding and continuous.

[h3]Localization and Accessibility[/h3]
One of the most notable advancements is the extensive localization effort. The chat server now auto-translates text into 28 different languages, facilitating seamless communication among players worldwide. Game texts have been localized into French, Japanese, Polish, Russian, and Simplified Chinese, making the game accessible to a broader audience worldwide. This move ensures that you can immerse yourself in the universe, overcoming language barriers and enhancing your overall experience. This is the first batch, and more languages will follow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/15b8864007b9c7907fc1caa60bfd2c722d8d7267.jpg[/img]

[h3]Enhanced User Interface and Controls[/h3]
User interface improvements have been a major focus. The introduction of context-sensitive controls further refines your experience, making navigation and interaction more intuitive. UI pinning support for essential elements like Cargo, Health Bars, FPS, and Ping has been added, giving you more control over your display preferences. Additionally, the integration of full controller and Steam Deck support means you can enjoy seamless gameplay across various devices.

FPS & Ping
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/19ed17a37821d8da2452558cd0ffa72c2002dc5a.jpg[/img]
Mouse & Keyboard:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/6edd0702245d6c214ea2c2cfe870cb021b6f8363.jpg[/img]
Xbox Controller (Steam Deck also supported):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/5415780b7255d96dda3e37912c9da4e4455d45be.jpg[/img]

[h3]Guides and Tutorials[/h3]
Recognizing the importance of onboarding new players, a comprehensive guide has been added that suggests what to do next, helping newcomers navigate the vastness of space. This guide is complemented by a small game guide window specifically designed for both new and returning players, ensuring you have the resources you need to succeed.

[h3]Monetization and Community Features[/h3]
A new monetization option with the Subspace License has been introduced, providing you with more flexible purchasing choices. This optional monthly purchase allows new players to join for free and then expand their experience with the license, which will unlock additional features and content over the coming months.

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
Numerous quality-of-life improvements have been made, from better tooltip information and enhanced mail layouts to the ability to auto-scroll chat windows. These small but significant tweaks collectively enhance your experience, making the game more enjoyable and user-friendly.

[h3]Voiceovers and Sound Enhancements[/h3]
To further immerse you in the universe, voiceovers have been added to the intro, tutorial, and gameplay, bringing the story and characters to life. Alongside new sounds and effects, these audio enhancements contribute to a more engaging and atmospheric experience.

[h3]Performance and Customization Enhancements[/h3]
Key settings have been introduced to enhance performance and customization. You can now set the maximum framerate (60, 90, 120, 144, or unlimited) and disable v-sync to maximize your hardware's potential. Additionally, a new option to adjust the UI size allows for a more personalized and comfortable interface, catering to your preferences and screen setups. These updates ensure a smoother and more adaptable gameplay experience.


Reflecting on the past year, it's clear that dedication to continuous improvement has paid off. The commitment to delivering an exceptional space MMO experience is unbroken, with exciting developments anticipated this year as we aim to reach the final release and add additional platforms.

[h2]Thank you for being a part of this journey![/h2]

notes.title: Unusual Signal - Update #2
notes.content:
In the vastness of space, four captains named Taromir, Sakuya, Torac, and the intriguingly named --__--, embarked on a journey through unexplored Subspace regions. During their voyage, they encountered a Subportal emitting an unusual signal.

Curious, the captains decided to investigate. Maintaining a safe distance, they maneuvered their ships for a closer examination. Taromir, the most experienced, suggested a coordinated scan of the portal. Sakuya, always cautious, recommended a careful approach. Torac, eager for action, disagreed, advocating for a more direct exploration. --__--, known for his quiet demeanor, observed silently and maneuvered his ship, resembling a long snake, into position.

While they debated, Taromir's analytical mind was busy decoding the portal's emissions. Meanwhile, Torac’s ship interface unexpectedly interacted with the portal, causing it to light up with a radiant glow.

This action led to an immediate and unexpected consequence: a bizarre signal began to resonate throughout Subspace, unlike anything they had encountered before. Taromir, analyzing the new data, warned of potential unknown effects. Realizing the potential dangers and wishing to keep their discovery under wraps, --__-- issued a fleet emergency jump.

What they didn't realize was that their actions had initiated a series of events that would soon unfold in unexpected ways.

[b]Update 25th December 2023[/b]
The STU Discovery team has made 15% progress in researching the mysterious item. They anticipate needing a few more days and the assistance of all captains to gather sufficient information to fully uncover its secrets.

[b]Update 29th December 2023[/b]
Over the past few days, the research team of the STU Discovery and the captains have been working tirelessly to advance their progress. As of today, they have made significant discoveries and estimate an achieved percentage of 81.25%. The team is optimistic about resolving the mystery surrounding the mysterious items in just 36 hours.

notes.title: Subspace Discovery - Roadmap Summer 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056511/45c2211ce78f4a3ce146c26afba06debf85c5e39.jpg[/img]

[h1]Shipyard[/h1]
Introducing the new Shipyard, where you can design and build your very own space ship! With a sleek new layout, you can use the resources and materials you’ve collected to construct ship parts, enhance their capabilities, and upgrade your ship’s Tier to reach new heights.

Choose from top ship manufacturers like Solid Division and TASULT, each offering unique bonuses to support class specializations such as Tank or Damage Dealer. You can even combine classes for maximum versatility.
With an increased Tier of hull pieces, their size grows and your ship becomes not just longer, but overall bigger and stronger.

Once your ship is constructed, outfit it with the latest weapons and shields, all from within the Shipyard. And with the integrated Forge, you can upgrade every single piece of your ship to create the ultimate space vessel. The possibilities are endless!

[h1]Technology[/h1]
Get ready for a whole new experience at the Research Station and Technology center, now featuring a complete overhaul with simplified menus and a streamlined research flow. Technologies have been carefully balanced for better progression and balance across ship classes.

The focus is now on research, so we’ve removed modules and integrated their production directly into the Shipyard. With these exciting changes, you’ll be able to explore new frontiers in Subspace like never before!

[h1]Forge[/h1]
Introducing The Forge, an all-new feature in Subspace Discovery that will revolutionize your gameplay experience! At the heart of your progression, The Forge empowers you to craft, enhance, and upgrade a wide range of items. From ship hulls to modules and special items, the possibilities are endless. And with the ability to enhance and upgrade your creations, you can unlock new levels of power and versatility. Imagine weapons that deal more damage and unlock new skills, or hull pieces that grant you more hitpoints and higher bonuses. With The Forge, you have the power to shape your own destiny and explore the depths of Subspace.
